# Default rounding modes that the OPTIONS of a copied table set
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tables (Table.defaultRoundingMode)
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language#create_table_like
#
# Each script creates the dataset unverified_rounding_plain, which has no default rounding mode, and
# tables of its own. The dataset stays in the project after the scripts run.
#
# BigQuery has answered that CREATE TABLE LIKE, COPY and CLONE keep the rounding modes of the
# source's columns and the source's default, which TestCopiedDefaultRoundingModes checks. The
# emulator rejects default_rounding_mode in their OPTIONS until these are answered.

# Whether the copied column n, which the source created without a rounding mode, takes the default
# that OPTIONS set, and whether the column m added later does: each 2.25 rounds to "2.2" if it
# does, and to "2.3" if it does not.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_rounding_plain;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.src (n NUMERIC(5, 1));
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.like_options LIKE unverified_rounding_plain.src OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN');
ALTER TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.like_options ADD COLUMN m NUMERIC(5, 1);
INSERT unverified_rounding_plain.like_options (n, m) VALUES (2.25, 2.25);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING([CAST(n AS STRING), CAST(m AS STRING)]) FROM unverified_rounding_plain.like_options
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_rounding_plain;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.src (n NUMERIC(5, 1));
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.copy_options COPY unverified_rounding_plain.src OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN');
ALTER TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.copy_options ADD COLUMN m NUMERIC(5, 1);
INSERT unverified_rounding_plain.copy_options (n, m) VALUES (2.25, 2.25);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING([CAST(n AS STRING), CAST(m AS STRING)]) FROM unverified_rounding_plain.copy_options
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_rounding_plain;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.src (n NUMERIC(5, 1));
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.clone_options CLONE unverified_rounding_plain.src OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN');
ALTER TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.clone_options ADD COLUMN m NUMERIC(5, 1);
INSERT unverified_rounding_plain.clone_options (n, m) VALUES (2.25, 2.25);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING([CAST(n AS STRING), CAST(m AS STRING)]) FROM unverified_rounding_plain.clone_options
?>

# Whether OPTIONS replace the source's default rather than keeping it: the added column m rounds
# 2.25 to "2.3" if they do, and to "2.2" if they do not.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_rounding_plain;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.even_src (i INT64) OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.like_replaced LIKE unverified_rounding_plain.even_src OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO');
ALTER TABLE unverified_rounding_plain.like_replaced ADD COLUMN m NUMERIC(5, 1);
INSERT unverified_rounding_plain.like_replaced (m) VALUES (2.25);
SELECT CAST(m AS STRING) FROM unverified_rounding_plain.like_replaced
?>
